action_summary: Prefer the historically stronger v52/v53 single-fold large-model experiment with its own config and the inferred model_fold0_last.pth artifact; retain the original v54 ensemble if that mount is absent. Keep v54 thresholds as an explicit initial mapping because the exact v52 values are unavailable. When the preferred run includes its own pred_df_fold0.csv, use its held-out essay IDs to recompute predictions with the selected checkpoint and fit bounded, shrunk QWK cutpoints, accepting them only after stratified cross-fitted improvement. This relies on that sidecar actually containing the run’s held-out fold. Preserve tokenizer, architecture and Kaggle paths, join final scores by essay_id, and save raw predictions plus calibration and artifact manifests. No leaderboard gain is measured locally; if the preferred artifacts are absent, the fallback preserves v54 predictions.
